about: Inkling-2-Mini (Thinking Machines' 26B looped MoE), ggml-org's IQ4_NL, at 131,072 tokens with q8_0 KV. Layers 6-17 are the loop core and run three times per token, so their experts go on the GPU first; at 128k only the experts of core layers 6-15 fit, and those of layers 0-5 and 16-23 stay in system RAM (--override-tensor). --no-op-offload: with a core layer's experts in RAM and op offload on, prompts of 32+ tokens come out NaN on master. -ub 64: the per-head relative-bias mask (n_kv x ubatch x 24 heads) is what limits 128k on 12 GB. This image is master 225a5345b; on that commit plus two F16-mask patches, with the same layout, it decoded 26.4 tok/s empty and 14.6 after a 124k prompt, needles 3/3 at 124k. The stock image itself passed the lab at 25.7 tok/s. Measured on one RTX 3060 12GB (PCIe 4.0 x16), i5-12500, 62 GiB RAM, with about 1 GB of the card held by the desktop.
